questions.source: Drill CH5 P1 — CI for proportion
questions.prompt: 132 of 400 subscribers would pay for an ad-free tier. Compute the point estimate **p̂** (3 decimals).
questions.explain: p̂ = 132/400 = **0.330**. The 95% CI: E = 1.96·√(0.33×0.67/400) = 1.96×0.0235 = 0.046 → **(0.284, 0.376)**. Interpretation sentence: 'We are 95% confident that the true proportion … is between 0.284 and 0.376.'

questions.prompt: Same data (p̂ = 0.330, n = 400, 95% → z = 1.96). Compute the UPPER limit of the CI (3 decimals).
σ = 1.2 min, target margin E = 0.25 at 90% confidence (z = 1.645). Required sample size n = ? (whole number — remember the rounding rule!)
questions.explain: n = (z·σ/E)² = (1.645×1.2/0.25)² = 7.896² = 62.35 → **round UP always** → **n = 63**. Rounding down would miss the precision target.

questions.source: Drill CH5 P3 — z or t?
questions.prompt: σ unknown, n = 12. Which distribution and df for the mean's CI?
questions.explain: **σ unknown + small n → t, df = n−1 = 11.** t(0.025, 11) = 2.201 for 95%. The z/t decision is the first mark of every Q1: σ known → z; σ unknown → t (df = n−1).

questions.prompt: Claim: "mean response time EXCEEDS 200 ms." The hypotheses are:
questions.explain: The claim ('exceeds') goes to **H₁: μ > 200**; H₀ always carries equality. Right-tailed → critical z(0.05) = 1.645.

questions.prompt: x̄ = 212, μ₀ = 200, σ = 35, n = 50. Compute z₀ = (x̄−μ₀)/(σ/√n) (3 decimals).
questions.explain: z₀ = 12/(35/√50) = 12/4.950 = **2.424** > 1.645 → reject H₀. Conclusion sentence: 'At α = 0.05 there is sufficient evidence that the mean response time exceeds 200 ms.'

questions.source: Drill CH5 P5 — two-tailed t verdict
questions.prompt: t₀ = −2.269, df = 9, α = 0.01 two-tailed → critical t(0.005, 9) = 3.250. Verdict?
options: Fail to reject H₀ — |−2.269| < 3.250: insufficient evidence the mean differs from 15
Reject H₀ — the statistic is negative
questions.explain: Two-tailed rule: reject iff **|t₀| > critical**. 2.269 < 3.250 → **fail to reject**. Write the full sentence: 'At α = 0.01 there is insufficient evidence that the mean session length differs from 15 minutes.'

questions.source: Drill CH5 P6 — χ² on σ (the sneaky one)
questions.prompt: Claim: σ < 2.5 days. n = 20, s = 1.9. Compute χ²₀ = (n−1)s²/σ₀² (3 decimals).
questions.explain: χ²₀ = 19×1.9²/2.5² = 19×3.61/6.25 = **10.974**. LEFT-tailed (claim 'less than') → critical = χ²(0.95, 19) = **10.117** (use the right-tail-0.95 column!). 10.974 > 10.117 → NOT in rejection region → **fail to reject**. The left-tail lookup is where everyone loses marks.
